tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Associate Technology Consultant
cover_en.hook: As an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with over 5 years of professional experience delivering enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Associate Technology Consultant position. My background combining backend Java engineering and techno-functional consulting aligns strongly with your technical consulting needs.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, adhering to best practices and platform design patterns.

bullets.label: API & Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to ensure seamless enterprise data flow.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business and IT by analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specifications, and translating them into scalable SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Platform Optimization
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, performed database query refactoring, and resolved critical integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and e-commerce systems.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I am currently serving a notice period ending on 15 December 2026, with my earliest start date on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience adds value to your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell to your consulting team. My background in building enterprise-grade Java applications, managing complex integrations, and bridging business requirements with technical delivery makes this role an ideal match.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, robust Java backend development, and techno-functional consulting skills to drive impactful enterprise e-commerce solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I have applied for the Associate Technology Consultant role and would welcome the chance to discuss how my Java and SAP Commerce expertise can benefit your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Associate Technology Consultant - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Associate Technology Consultant position. With over 5 years of professional experience as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, and complex enterprise integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving a notice period until 15 December 2026 (earliest start 16 December 2026). I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
